rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight accomplishments
conjunction adding to the preceding list
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ becomes siddhisaṃprāptir before mūlakaulam

items.question: What attainment constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The attainment of these accomplishments is identified as the root Kaula.
This identification is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight siddhis constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of mūlakaula in this context is not fully specified within the verse.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
